description: This file defines the MyClaimRequestAPI class, a REST API controller for managing claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests, with validation rules, OpenAPI annotations for documentation, and integration with models and DTOs specific to claim requests.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for handling claim request operations specific to the authenticated user's claims, extending EmployeeClaimRequestAPI, with methods for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new claim request, calling the parent implementation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single claim request by ID, calling the parent implementation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim requests for the authenticated user, calling the parent implementation.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Determines if the operation pertains to the authenticated employee based on employee number; always returns true in this context.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a claim request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific claim request by ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams for filtering claim requests.

methods.name: getEndPointCollectionResult
methods.description: Creates a collection result object with the appropriate model class based on the 'model' parameter, encapsulating claim request data and metadata.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter to only include the authenticated user's employee number in search queries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing claim requests, including sorting and pagination parameters.
